title: Mechanistic insights into carbon steel corrosion inhibition by benzodiazepine derivatives in hydrochloric acid
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,20677-20693
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00049E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
N. Timoudan, L. Chahir, A. Marzaq, R. Saddik, S. Tighadouini, I. Warad, B. Dikici, Ahmed A. Farag, F. Bentiss, A. Zarrouk
SR3 and SR4 benzodiazepine derivatives effectively inhibit carbon steel corrosion in 1 M HCl. Surface analyses confirm adsorption of the inhibitors on the carbon steel surface. DFT and MD simulations elucidate the inhibition mechanism.
